description: F5 opens the Payment voucher in SINGLE-ENTRY mode without the user touching Ctrl+H. Tally defaults Payment / Receipt / Contra to single entry (one account on one side, multiple on the other), which is why bulk cash work is fast there; a clone that opened them in double entry would cost a Tally operator a keystroke on every voucher. The frame carries no entryMode of its own — an absent config means 'the class default', so the config only ever records a deviation the user chose.
